query:
SELECT id, name, dayOfWeek, startTime, endTime, time, organizationId, isActive
FROM classes 
WHERE (dayOfWeek LIKE '%Saturday%' OR dayOfWeek LIKE '%Sat%')
ORDER BY startTime;
